entries.en: So d'you get that loan in the end?
entries.ro: Până la urmă ai luat împrumutul?

entries.en: No. Said my rating was too low.
entries.ro: Nu. Au zis că ratingul meu e prea mic.

entries.en: How the hell should I know? If their "system" says it's too low – it's too low.
entries.ro: Cum dracu' să știu? Dacă „sistemul” lor zice că e prea mic – e prea mic.
